title: Hai Kaun O Makaan Mein Aaj Mataam
body:
Hai Kaun O Makaan Mein Aaj Mataam
<<MINI>>
Duniya Se Uthe Rasool E Akram
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Par Yeh Kainaat Ke Gham
<<MINI>>
Duniya Se Uthe Rasool E Akram
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Taboot Nabi Ka Uth Ra Hai
Sar Nange Har Ek Barhana Paa Hai
Kunba Hai Tamaam Sarfe Mataam
<<MINI>>
Duniya Se Uthe Rasool....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Behaal Hai Beti Mustafa Ki
Behaal Hai Sab Har Ek Nawasi
Roote Hai Nawase Sar Kiye Qham
<<MINI>>
Duniya Se Uthe Rasool....
